column3: Close to the Hebrew; “The daughters” is rendered “the maidens,” and “friend” as “darling.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The sons” is rendered “the young men,” and “I desired and sat” as “I took great delight and sat down.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The house of wine” is rendered “his banquet hall,” and “standard” as “banner.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Weak of love” is rendered “lovesick.”
The Hebrew is a statement (“his left hand [is] under my head”); NASB renders it as a wish, “Let his left hand be.”
The oath formula “if you awaken” is rendered “That you will not arouse,” and “the love … until it pleases” as “my love, Until she pleases.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The sound of my beloved” is rendered “Listen! My beloved!,” and “leaping … bounding” as “Climbing … Leaping.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The fawn of the deer” is rendered “a young stag,” and “gazing from the windows” as “looking through the windows.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Come for yourself” is rendered “come along.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “already” and “the vines”; “the time of pruning” could also be read “the time of singing.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Its early figs” is rendered “its figs.”
Close to the Hebrew; “The steep place” is rendered “the steep pathway.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Foxes, little foxes” is rendered “The little foxes,” and “and our vineyards [are in] blossom” as “While our vineyards are in blossom.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Grazing” is rendered “pastures his flock.”
“Until the day breathes” is rendered “Until the cool of the day,” and “the mountains of ravine” as the place name “Bether.”
